facts: The Met links the burial to Mendes / Tell el-Rub'a and the Egyptian Antiquities Service excavation of 1902.
The assemblage includes more than 360 shabtis, fragments, several amulets, a mummy with gold-leaf trappings, and a second nearly empty chamber where gold-leaf fragments were noted.
The Met points to Cairo CG 53465-53469 for related mummy equipment.
